name: Yaogan 50-04
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
destination_explanation: It starts around 160 km up and runs to about 2,000 km. At this height a satellite goes all the way around the planet in about an hour and a half.
slot_a_text: The Yaogan 50-04 is a Chinese military “remote sensing” satellite of unknown purposes.
slot_b_text: Low Earth orbit is anywhere from about 160 to 2,000 km up, where a satellite laps the planet roughly every 90 minutes. Everything there is falling; it just keeps missing the ground.
